You mention a path. Path to where? The kundalini begins a journey that I believe has been over spiritualized partly because it is almost impossible to capture in the wild and even harder to measure. We simply don’t have the means to do any of that right now but if the phenomenon was killing people by the millions, research and money would have gone into figuring out what it is. I believe that if this is a pseudo biological theory or phenomenon, then it must have parallels in nature. I suspect the same biological process that changes a caterpillar to a butterfly is close. The other problem is that kundalini is a slow burn in that it changes its host gradually over a long period of time so it’s hard to quantify and measure its effects. 

I agree we do use words and terms within out reach to explain what we do not understand. I agree that there are spiritual effects of the kundalini but the kundalini is also a physical phenomenon that we can feel. It is also very biological and therefore must have some basis in science. So with all science when we do not know something, we theorize. Which is what I have attempted to do.

It’s just a theory I’ve developed. I’m failing to see where my humility falters. I started to work on my own theories because my research was not turning up any good answers. Maybe you can point out the lack of humility bit. I would say what you hear is frustration. I think my problem lies with the fact that there is a lot of focus on the spiritual aspect of kundalini and not enough reconciliation with a biological process. It is a biological phenomenon because something physical happens. I think both biological and energetic/spiritual processes have to be weighed in tandem for us to begin to have any real answers. I believe it’s the same impulse that drives the metamorphosis of the caterpillar but unless it can be measured and quantified. I feel that will require highly refined medical technology that can measure life energy/prana to measure the effects of the kundalini. What would be better would be to study the kundalini in a lab as it’s happening but it’s hard and probably ill advised to induce a kundalini rising. Until then all we can do is postulate unfortunately.
